description: Renders a native <button> element. All standard button semantics and keyboard interactions are handled by the browser.

focus.notes: Focus ring uses a 3px ring with ring-ring/50 color. Disabled buttons remove pointer events and reduce opacity.

announcements: The button label is announced as its accessible name
Variant and size do not affect announcements

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for all variants)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: When using icon-only buttons, always provide an aria-label
When using asChild, ensure the child element is semantically appropriate
Disabled buttons should include a tooltip or adjacent text explaining why
